text:
ITEM 1 | Dark green fresh leaves (spinach-like), wilted and glossy with slight moisture, scattered with thin orange shreds on top, sitting at upper-left of plate, footprint roughly 25% of plate diameter area, leaves about 1-2 mm thick in a loose mound about 2-3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange-yellow cheese strands scattered over the greens, some slightly melted, thin strands about 3-5 cm long | 8
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown baked flatbread or pizza-like wedge with red tomato sauce layer and melted cheese on top, triangular piece about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick, crisp edges, sits at upper-right of plate | 75
ITEM 4 | Sliced carrots, orange with slightly glossy surface and firm texture, rounds about 0.5 cm thick and 3 cm across, some with caramelized edges, sitting beside the flatbread at right | 40
ITEM 5 | Sliced zucchini, pale green skin with lighter flesh, firm, rounds about 0.5 cm thick and 3-4 cm across, some halved into half-moons, sitting in the lower-right area | 65
ITEM 6 | Broccoli florets, bright green, firm and slightly moist, florets about 2-3 cm across with stems, at right-center beside zucchini | 30
ITEM 7 | Shredded cooked chicken breast, pale golden-tan with light browning and seasoning crust, moist-looking, pieces about 4-6 cm long and 1 cm thick in fibrous strands, piled in center-left of plate | 110
ITEM 8 | Light brown sauce or seasoning residue, thin and matte, spread in small specks and smears around the chicken on the plate surface | 5
